parsed.rationale: Two identical `MockDiscogsEntityResolver` type-alias-object declarations exist across two packages: one in `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift` (package `Metadata`) and one in `WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift` (package `app:iOS`). The structural evidence confirms 4 shared fields and exact duplication (`query: exact-duplicates`). Since the mock is already present in the `Metadata` package — which is the natural home for anything related to Discogs entity resolution — the `app:iOS` copy should be removed and the test in `DiscogsFormatterTests.swift` should import and reuse the one from `Metadata`. This eliminates the risk of the two copies drifting apart as the underlying protocol evolves.
